description:
China A-share Level 2 Trades
	

Canonical Level 2 trade records for China A-shares, stored as one fact table.

	
		
	
	
		Coverage
	


Date range: 2026-04-01 to 2026-11-26
Trading days: 158
Rows: 23969321324
Parquet files: 1103
Compressed local size: 191.62 GiB


	
		
	
	
		Layout
	

data/l2_trades/
  trade_date=YYYY-MM-DD/
    code_prefix=00/
      part-00000.parquet

code_prefix is ticker[:2]. For example, 000001 -> 00, 300750 -> 30, 600519 -> 60, and 688981 -> 68.
